substantive_reconstruction.interfaces: Let t denote the retained pair of indices and b_t the queried fixed-point record. O maps |0>_V|t> to |b_t>_V|t> coherently. A superposition of t therefore carries correlated records, not a freely readable classical list. Basis-record CNOT fanout is compatible with no-cloning, but neither it nor measurement gives free coherent amplitude loading. An entry amplitude is a different interface, whose ideal target is normalized only for |z_t|<=1. This construction derives it from available digital access; another model or a known constant can supply it differently.
substantive_reconstruction.signed_complex_loader: With stored q_t in[0,1/2] and p_t modulo1, define z_hat=exp(2*pi*i*p_t)cos(pi*q_t). Apply Ry(2*pi*q_t) to signal0, then D(p)=diag(exp(2*pi*i*p),1). Its column is exactly (z_hat,sin(pi*q_t)); the latter is nonnegative and equals sqrt(1-|z_hat|^2). Zero has q=1/2, with arbitrary phase convention p=0 and no division by magnitude; magnitude1 has q=0 and retains the phase. A negative real value can use p=1/2. Replacing D by Rz while discarding its label-dependent global factor is invalid coherently. Bit-controlled rotations implement the stated binary angle; d+e ideal controls are not automatically that many elementary hardware gates.
substantive_reconstruction.transcript_and_cleanup: Use registers S,V,Q,P,R,T, with widths1,d',d,e,w and the index width. Starting at clean work and fixed t: O writes b_t; reversible C preserves b_t,t and computes q_t,p_t,g_t; R_sig changes only S; C† restores Q,P,R to zero on both signal branches; O† restores V. Hence the final signal vector tensored with clean work and t follows, and linearity gives the same clean interface for arbitrary coherent input. Arithmetic garbage may remain between C and C†: it need not be separately cleared before rotation, because all controls and the retained value are preserved. Abstract existence of O† is not an oracle-access promise; an XOR entry oracle is self-inverse, a known circuit may be reversed at cost, and a genuinely forward-only black box does not silently supply this implementation.
substantive_reconstruction.resource_ledger_and_fusion: For the explicit chronological O;C;R_sig;C†;O† circuit, the original-entry query ledger is1 forward plus1 inverse. Remaining gates cost2G_C+G_R and simultaneous clean temporary work is d'+d+e+w, besides the retained signal/indices/outer registers. Returning these qubits clean permits reuse but does not remove them from peak physical space. Separately packaging a clean angle oracle B=O;F;O† makes B;R;B† naively cost4 original queries. R acts on signal/angle/phase and O on value/indices, so the middle O†;R;O can be replaced by R; the fused circuit recovers2 queries while retaining the value. Thus cleanup is charged, not an unavoidable universal extra2-query theorem or a ban on amortization.
substantive_reconstruction.projection_precision_and_cost_limits: Compressing signal0 gives the diagonal operator D_z on the combined label, not the full matrix A merely because labels are called row and column. For density rho the success probability is sum_t rho_tt|z_hat_t|^2; the conditioned state is D_z rho D_z†/p only when p>0. Tracing leftover records generally dephases joint signal/index coherence, though basis inputs and signal-only marginals can be exceptions. Exactness is for stored parameters with ideal gates. Differentiating the unit signal vector gives q-derivative norm pi and phase-derivative norm<=2pi, yielding the stated pi*delta_q+2pi*circular_delta_p bound plus synthesis error. Data-to-angle error near endpoints, actual reversible arithmetic runtime, inverse capability, rotation synthesis and outer sparse-access costs remain separate obligations.
